svg.aria-label: The seven packages of the pipekit workspace and the umbrella. Every one imports pipekit-ops, the first foundation. pipekit-jax also imports pipekit-cycle, and pipekit-array through its array extra; pipekit-train imports pipekit-experiment through its experiment extra. pipekit-array, the second foundation, imports only pipekit-ops, and pipekit-ops imports nothing. Imported on main by geotoolz, gridax, geophysix, radiomax, tracerax, diagnostix, plumax, radtrax, sesmax, somax, vardax.
svg.title: The packages of the pipekit workspace

svg.text: the Python standard library alone: no dependencies
geotoolz · gridax · geophysix · radiomax · tracerax · diagnostix · plumax · radtrax · sesmax · somax · vardax
imports it through an optional extra
Not drawn: pipekit-cycle's array extra and pipekit-train's cycle extra install a sibling and import nothing from it,
and pipekit-evaluate's cycle extra imports pipekit-cycle for type checking only.
